segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus used a picture His listeners knew well — a shepherd and his sheep, out on the open hill.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not a hired hand counting a herd — a shepherd who knows them one at a time, and is known back.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But the flock was bigger than the people standing in front of Him.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There were other sheep, not of that pen, that He would also bring.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They would hear His voice. And the result would be one flock, one Shepherd.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not divided by nation or wall. One voice, one care, one Shepherd over all who listen.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Whoever hears Him belongs — wherever they're from.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His voice reaches further than you think. Hear Him, and you're in the fold.
